entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah... I'm calling because I need to return something. I'm just so disappointed, I saved up for this.
I'm sorry to hear there's an issue. I can definitely look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF95114. It's for that new jersey. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, I just feel let down.
Okay, I've pulled up your order. I see the jersey was delivered 29 days ago. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?

It's the wrong size. I always get a large, but this one is just way too tight in the arms. I can't even ride in it. I was so excited, and now I just have a jersey I can't use. I really needed this money back for holiday gifts.
I can certainly understand your frustration when the fit isn't right. Let me just confirm the policy for that item. One moment.

Okay, I have good news for you. That jersey falls under our standard 90-day return policy. Since you're at day 29, you are well within the window to send it back for a full refund. We could also do an exchange for the next size up if you'd like.
Oh, a full refund is possible? That's a huge relief. Thank you so much, Sarah. I was so worried I was stuck with it. I think I'll just take the refund for now.

Of course. I've just processed the return authorization. I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label right now. Just place the jersey in a box, attach the label, and drop it at any post office. Your refund will be issued as soon as our warehouse receives it.
That's perfect. You've been a really big help today.
I'm happy I could resolve this for you. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that was everything. Thanks again.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
